title: 第14章 筑基期之威
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

后山矿洞外。

林渊刚引爆天雷子，正借助夜色向废弃矿洞前行。

他身法极轻，没有发出声响。

接近入口时，他目光微动，迅速贴在一块巨石的阴影中。

百丈外，晃动着几道微弱的法力荧光。

“搜仔细点。老祖交代过，前山林家嫡系死的死、降的降，但保不齐有人在后山留了暗道。”

一个粗粝的声音传开。

林渊看清了局势。

那是五名刘家修士，为首刘家子弟，炼气九层修为。

他身后跟着四名刘家子弟，分别是两名炼气七层和两名炼气八层，正手持法器四处扫视。

这群人驻守的位置，正好挡住了废弃矿洞的入口。

林渊隐在暗处，眉头微皱。

他原计划从这处连通暗河的矿洞离开，没想到刘莽连这种废弃矿区都布置了搜查队。

“等一下，不对劲！”

洞口附近的刘铁突然停下脚步，死死盯着一处怪石堆。

他一拍储物袋，一柄一阶中品法器大刀落在手中。

“头儿，怎么了？”

后方一名炼气七层修士凑上来问。

刘铁冷笑，大刀向前一指，法力汇聚双目：“这里的乱石排列有五行汇聚的痕迹。老子在矿场学过破阵，这明显是最下品的幻阵痕迹。这里有人，刚进去不久！”

其余四名修士闻言，立刻祭出法器，将怪石堆围了起来。

阴影中，林渊心中了然。

林大山一家刚持遁地符从矿道离开，虽然是在内部激发，但经过洞口时，还是让外面的残存禁制产生了一丝灵力涟漪。

行踪已经暴露。

以林渊如今筑基初期的修为，若要强行遁走，这五人根本拦不住。

但林渊的目光此时却锁在了刘铁的左手手腕处。

那里系着一根竹筒，表面刻满赤红符文，正散发着丝丝热气。

那是刘家特制的传讯烟花。

此物一旦激发，能瞬间冲上千丈高空，爆发出无法隔绝的血色火光。

后山距离前山不过十几里，烟花一响，半空中的筑基中期修士刘莽十息内就能赶到。

到时候，不仅到手的资源保不住，他隐藏筑基修为的秘密也会彻底暴露。

在两家联手清算林家的时刻，一个来历不明的筑基修士，必然会遭到疯狂围剿。

更别说是林家的筑基修士。

“让他们放松警惕，必须瞬杀，绝不能让他放出传讯。”

林渊脑海中闪过这个念头。

既然避不开，那就只能杀人灭口。

“沙沙……”

一阵轻微的脚步声在乱石堆旁响起。

“谁？！”

刘铁暴喝，手中大刀法力涌动，直指左侧阴影。

月光下，一名身穿青色破旧道袍的年轻男子缓缓走出。

他用敛气术将身上的气息稳定在炼气九层，显得有些虚浮。

“林家余孽？”

刘铁先是一惊，随即冷笑起来，“运气不错，抓了你，去老祖那能领五十块下品灵石。”

“动手，废了四肢，留活口！”

刘铁没有任何单挑的意思，大手一挥，命令麾下围攻。

“围起来！”

四名刘家修士立刻散开，各自掐诀。

瞬间，两道风刃与一团火球撕裂夜空，夹杂着一柄下品飞剑，齐齐朝林渊砸来。

四人同时出手，法力交织，威势不弱。

林渊站在原地，脸色毫无波动。

眼看攻击临身，他右手一抬，一面巴掌大小、布满金色鳞片的盾牌飞出，迎风便涨，化作丈许大小的巨盾挡在身前。

二阶下品防御法器，金鳞盾。

Page (1/3)

Outside the back mountain mine.

Lin Yuan had just detonated Tianleizi and was heading towards the abandoned mine under the cover of night.

His movements were extremely light and he made no sound.

As he approached the entrance, his eyes moved slightly and quickly settled in the shadow of a boulder.

A hundred feet away, there were several weak mana fluorescent lights shaking.

"Search carefully. Our ancestors told us that the direct descendants of the Lin family in the front mountain died and surrendered, but if they were not preserved, someone left a secret passage in the back mountain."

A rough voice spread.

Lin Yuan saw the situation clearly.

They were five Liu family monks, headed by Liu family disciples, who were at the ninth level of Qi refining.

Behind him were four Liu family disciples, two on the seventh level of Qi Refining and two on the eighth level of Qi Refining. They were looking around with magic weapons in hand.

The position where this group of people was stationed happened to block the entrance to the abandoned mine.

Lin Yuan hid in the darkness, frowning slightly.

He originally planned to leave from this mine connected to the underground river, but he didn't expect that Liu Mang even deployed a search team in such an abandoned mining area.

"Wait a minute, something's wrong!"

Liu Tie, who was near the entrance of the cave, suddenly stopped and stared at a pile of strange rocks.

He patted the storage bag, and a first-level mid-grade magic weapon, a broadsword, fell into his hand.

"Boss, what's wrong?"

A seventh-level Qi Refining monk from behind came up and asked.

Liu Tie sneered, pointed his sword forward, and focused his magic power on his eyes: "The arrangement of rocks here has traces of the convergence of the five elements. I learned to break formations in the mine, and these are obviously traces of the lowest-grade phantom formations. There is someone here, and they just entered not long ago!"

When the other four monks heard this, they immediately took out their magic weapons and surrounded the pile of strange rocks.

In the shadow, Lin Yuan understood clearly.

Lin Dashan's family had just left the mine tunnel with the Earth Escape Talisman. Although it was activated internally, when they passed the cave entrance, the remaining restrictions outside still produced a trace of spiritual power ripples.

The whereabouts have been exposed.

With Lin Yuan's current cultivation level in the early stages of foundation building, if he wanted to forcefully escape, these five people would not be able to stop him.

But Lin Yuan's eyes were locked on Liu Tie's left wrist.

There was a bamboo tube tied there, with red runes engraved on its surface, and it was emitting a trace of heat.

Those were the Liu family's specially-made messenger fireworks.

Once this object is activated, it can instantly soar thousands of feet into the sky, bursting out with blood-colored fire that cannot be isolated.

The back mountain is only a dozen miles away from the front mountain. As soon as the fireworks go off, Liu Mang, a monk in the middle stage of foundation building in mid-air, can arrive within ten breaths.

At that time, not only will the resources obtained be lost, but the secret of his hidden foundation-building cultivation will also be completely exposed.

When the two families join forces to liquidate the Lin family, a foundation-building monk of unknown origin will inevitably be frantically suppressed.

Not to mention the foundation-building monk of the Lin family.

"To make them relax their vigilance, they must kill instantly and must not let him be released for summons."

This thought flashed through Lin Yuan's mind.

Since you can't avoid it, you can only kill people and silence them.

"Shasha..."

A soft sound of footsteps sounded beside the pile of rocks.

"Who?!"

Liu Tie shouted violently, and the magic power of the sword in his hand surged, pointing directly at the shadow on the left.

Under the moonlight, a young man wearing a shabby blue robe slowly walked out.

He used the Qi Condensation Technique to stabilize the aura on his body at the ninth level of Qi Refining, which made him appear a bit vain.

"The remnants of the Lin family?"

Liu Tie was startled at first, then sneered, "You're lucky. If I catch you, I can get fifty yuan of low-grade spiritual stones from my ancestor."

"Do it, lose all your limbs, and leave one alive!"

Liu Tie didn't have any intention of fighting alone. With a wave of his hand, he ordered his subordinates to besiege.

"Surround it up!"

The four Liu family monks immediately dispersed and each said goodbye.

In an instant, two wind blades and a ball of fire tore through the night sky, mixed with a low-grade flying sword, and they all hit Lin Yuan.

The four of them took action at the same time, their magic powers were intertwined, and their power was not weak.

Lin Yuan stood where he was, his expression unwavering.

Seeing the attack coming, he raised his right hand, and a palm-sized shield covered with golden scales flew out. It swelled in the wind and turned into a giant shield about ten feet in size to block in front of him.

A second-level low-grade defensive weapon, the golden scale shield.
